text.p: Results of feature races on the
third day of the four-day Royal Ascot meeting on Thursday:
Ribblesdale Stakes, a group two race for three-year-old
fillies, run over one and a half miles (2.4 kms)
1. Yashmak 7-2 (ridden by Kieren Fallon)
2. Akdariya 9-1 (John Murtagh)
3. Crown of Light 100-30 favourite (Frankie Dettori)
Nine ran.
Distances: Nine lengths, three and a half lengths.
Winner owned by Prince Khalid Abdulla, trained by Henry
Cecil at Newmarket in England.
Value to winner: 69,588 pounds sterling ($113,425)
Ascot Gold Cup, a group one race for four-year-olds and
upwards, run over two and a half miles (4 kms)
1. Celeric 11-2 (Pat Eddery)
2. Classic Cliche 6-1 (Frankie Dettori)
3. Election Day 25-1 (Michael Kinane)
13 ran. Persian Punch was the 9-2 favourite.
Distances: Three-quarters of a length, one length.
Winner owned by Christopher Spence, trained by David Morley
at Newmarket in England.
Value to winner: 113,556 pounds sterling ($185,100).
